mapper.select: SELECT id, station_id, person_id, event_type, payload_json, client_event_id, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM ccds_attack_event WHERE client_event_id = #{clientEventId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ccds_attack_event (station_id, person_id, event_type, payload_json, client_event_id, gmt_create, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{stationId}, #{personId}, #{eventType}, #{payloadJson}, #{clientEventId}, #{gmtCreate}, #{gmtModified})
